SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

Identify the exact river section and arrange local tackle guidance before arrival. Do not apply a country-wide species list to the selected reach. A compact day plan should include the meeting point, bank accessibility and somewhere to store wet equipment afterward.

Choose a reach and presentation

A river name is not a complete day plan. Decide the reach, bank access and presentation first. Ask for the useful lure weight or fly-line arrangement, then match the rod, reel and leader to that answer. Wading is a separate decision and is not assumed in this brief.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Luxembourg

Anglers aged 14 and above need an inland fishing permit. Private category 2 waters also require the owner's written permission; border waters have a separate permit system.

  • 1 monthEUR 4
  • 1 monthEUR 6
  • 1 monthEUR 8
Official rules ↗

Permits for this trip

  • German–Luxembourg border-water permit ↗
    Anglers on the shared border reaches; an inland Luxembourg permit does not replace it. Apply and pay online through MyGuichet; select the bank or boat category as applicable.
